- Tomato leaf with yellowish-bronze stippling/speckling across the upper surface
- Mottled, dull appearance with yellowish patches scattered irregularly
- No distinct circular lesions, concentric rings, dark borders, or necrotic spots
- No obvious fungal/bacterial spot patterns

**Comparison with reference:**
The Spider_Mites reference collage (especially top-left) is nearly identical — same yellowish-bronze mottling and stippled dull appearance, same leaf shape, same background. The symptom description matches perfectly: "yellowish to bronze stippling or speckling on leaves" with a "mottled or speckled, dull appearance."

No other class fits: Early_Blight/Target_Spot would show concentric ring lesions; Bacterial_Spot would show small dark discrete spots; Leaf_Mold would show yellow spots with olive undersides; Mosaic viruses show mosaic/curl patterns.
